caveat: cold run on an otherwise idle laptop (empty uv cache, new venv); the final tagged commit differs from the verified run commit only by this record, and its own verification is in the annotated tag message
method: git clone into a clean directory outside the working tree, checkout of the tag commit; uv sync --frozen with a fresh empty UV_CACHE_DIR and a new .venv; `demo` run from the COMMITTED artifacts; then the README quick-start commands in order with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 (make is not installed on the verification machine; the Makefile reproduce target runs the same ten stages in the same order). Implemented by scripts/verify_fresh_clone.sh.
metrics_json_sha256_note: the first hash is of the Windows (CRLF) working-tree file that the verification script hashes; the second is of the LF blob as committed, which is what a Linux or macOS checkout hashes. Both are of results/metrics.json at the run commit; the final tagged commit differs from it only by this record.
where_the_verified_sha_is: a commit cannot contain its own SHA, so the exact SHA verified at the FINAL tagged commit, its timings and both metrics.json hashes are recorded in the annotated tag message (`git show v1.1-konnect-submission`); `bash scripts/verify_fresh_clone.sh` repeats the check for any ref. The numbers here are from the cold-clone run of the commit recorded above.
